game.dusk_warning: Solar panels stop at night. Save your power!
game.battery_forecast: At this rate, battery lasts about {seconds} seconds.
game.energy_critical: Power is empty! Base shuts down in {seconds}s!
game.boredom_critical: Crew is upset! Base gives up in {seconds}s!

win.title: Mission Accomplished!
win.reason: You completed Planet Stats and survived three lunar days!
hints: Solar arrays make clean energy while the Sun is up.
Fuel cells give steady power when night falls.
A happy crew keeps events from happening too quickly.

lose.title: Mission Failed
lose.energy_reason: The base ran out of power for too long.
lose.boredom_reason: The crew got too bored and left their posts.
energy_hints: Build extra fuel cells before the long night begins.
Turn off science buildings at night to save precious power.
boredom_hints: Build a Gym or Cafe to cheer up your crew.
Do not let the Event meter fill up all the way.

energy.name: Energy
energy.desc: Power available for your lights, heat, and machines.
energy.why_dropping: Energy is dropping because buildings use power.
energy.why_rising: Energy is rising from your generators.

science.name: Science
science.desc: Research points earned by labs to unlock new tech.
science.why_rising: Scientists are discovering new lunar data.

boredom.name: Boredom
boredom.desc: Crew mood. Lower is better so everyone stays focused.
boredom.why_dropping: The crew is relaxing at fun activities.
boredom.why_rising: Working on the Moon gets lonely over time.

revenue.name: Revenue
revenue.desc: Money to spend on new buildings and base repairs.
revenue.why_dropping: Funds spent on construction and maintenance.
revenue.why_rising: Income earned from data and mining operations.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Risk meter. When full, a major hazard will strike.
event.why_dropping: A happy crew helps prevent accidents.
event.why_rising: High boredom increases base hazard chances.

habitat_pod.name: Habitat Pod
habitat_pod.desc: Living quarters for your astronauts. Keeps crew safe and warm.

fuel_cell.name: Fuel Cell Generator
fuel_cell.desc: Combines hydrogen and oxygen. Creates clean power and pure water.

solar_array.name: Solar Array
solar_array.desc: Turns sunlight into abundant electricity. Stops working at night.

nuclear_plant.name: Nuclear Plant
nuclear_plant.desc: Powerful fission generator. Delivers steady energy day and night.

datacentre.name: Datacentre
datacentre.desc: Processes space communications. Earns revenue from scientific missions.

metal_mining.name: Metal Mining
metal_mining.desc: Extracts titanium and iron from regolith. Regolith is crushed Moon rock.

helium3_extraction.name: Helium-3 Extraction
helium3_extraction.desc: Harvests trapped solar fuel. High revenue for clean Earth energy.

gym.name: Lunar Gym
gym.desc: Astronauts exercise in low gravity. Keeps your crew healthy and happy.

cafe.name: Base Cafe
cafe.desc: A cozy gathering spot. Hot drinks and meals lower crew boredom.

restaurant.name: Hydroponic Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Fresh food grown in nutrient water. Makes the crew feel right at home.

lab.name: Research Lab
lab.desc: Analyzes lunar soil samples. Produces steady science points.

land_research.name: Land Research Station
land_research.desc: Surveys Moon craters and subsurface caves. Generates advanced science.

planet_stats.name: Planet Stats Observatory
planet_stats.desc: Final mission goal! Unlocks deep planetary knowledge to win the game.

regolith.text: Regolith is lunar soil made of crushed rock and dust.

helium3.text: Helium-3 is solar fuel trapped inside Moon soil.

lunar_night.text: Night on the Moon lasts about 14 Earth days.
